sloka: सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः ।एष देवासुरगणान् लोकान् पाति गभिस्तिभिः ।। ६.१०७.७ ।।
transliteration: sarvadevātmako hyeṣa tejasvī raśmibhāvanaḥ ।eṣa devāsuragaṇān lokān pāti gabhistibhiḥ ।। 6.107.7 ।।

translations.english: "He is the self in all, glorious, he sustains by his rays of light, the gods, suras and the whole world. He is the Lord of all.
